name: Joez Social Snippets — Social Content Generator
author: joez300

sections.description:
Advanced AI-powered content generation tool built specifically for WordPress. It leverages OpenAI and Claude APIs to help you create professional, platform-optimized social media content.

External services

This plugin relies on 3rd party AI services to generate content and images. To use these features, an API key from the service provider is required.

  • OpenAI API: Used for generating text content and DALL-E images.
    • Data sent: The article topic and visual descriptions provided by the user.
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
